responsibility: Declares the RTL-specific CFG manipulation API provided by `cfgrtl.cc`. It exposes functions for deleting or relinking insns and insn chains, mapping insns to basic blocks, querying block emptiness and fallthrough legality, obtaining block labels and notes, inserting insns on edges and committing them, updating branch-probability notes, purging dead edges, fixing abnormal edges and partitions, duplicating insn chains, entering or leaving cfglayout mode, and initializing RTL per-block info, serving as the backend-facing header for RTL CFG synchronization.
same_name_distinction: Declares the externally used RTL CFG-manipulation and insn-chain APIs, while cfgrtl.cc supplies the RTL-aware implementations and cfg_hooks table definitions.
